notes: Rank = biggest-bang score (reach+differentiation+pain+proof-now, max 20). Ordered for the catalog + carousel. impact.note: The beachhead. Only wxKanban does this for WinDev/PCSoft shops; guided, done-with-you, demoable (conversion skills live-tested on real apps).

features.name: Cross From WinDev to AI-Built Software You Own
features.valueProp: A guided bridge that converts your WINDEV / WEBDEV (also VB6, Clarion) app into a modern React + Tailwind stack you own outright.
features.benefit: Escape proprietary lock-in without a risky big-bang rewrite — done with you, screen by screen.

banner.headline: From WinDev to software you own.
banner.subhead: Convert your app to a modern stack — guided, screen by screen.

fr-FR.name: Passez de WINDEV à un logiciel IA que vous possédez

fr-FR.benefit: Sortez du verrouillage propriétaire sans réécriture risquée — accompagné, écran par écran.

banner.headline: De WINDEV à un logiciel qui vous appartient.
banner.subhead: Convertissez votre app vers une pile moderne — accompagné, écran par écran.

impact.note: Signature methodology + the educational mission. Enforced 6-phase gate; built and running the product itself.

features.name: Ship Nothing Untested — the 6-Phase Lifecycle
features.valueProp: Every project moves through Design → Implementation → QA → Human Testing → Beta → Release, with gates that won't let unfinished work advance.
features.benefit: Build the judgment and habits of a senior engineer — the methodology is enforced, not optional.

banner.headline: Ship nothing untested.
banner.subhead: Six enforced phases from design to release.

fr-FR.name: Ne livrez rien sans tests — le cycle en 6 phases
fr-FR.valueProp: Chaque projet passe par Conception → Implémentation → QA → Tests humains → Bêta → Livraison, avec des portes qui bloquent le travail inachevé.
fr-FR.benefit: Acquérez le jugement et les réflexes d'un ingénieur senior — la méthode est imposée, pas optionnelle.

banner.headline: Ne livrez rien sans tests.
banner.subhead: Six phases imposées, de la conception à la livraison.

impact.note: Broadest daily pain; built. Every multi-tool developer feels it.

features.name: One Board for Every PM Tool
features.valueProp: See and work every task from Jira, Monday, Asana, and Trello — plus your own internal tasks — in a single board, changes syncing back.
features.benefit: Stop paying the context-switch tax across five tools.

banner.headline: One board. Every tool.
banner.subhead: Jira, Monday, Asana, Trello — and your own tasks, unified.

impact.note: Consultants' revenue core; built end-to-end (timers → invoices).

features.name: Bill Every Minute — Timers to Invoices
features.valueProp: Track billable time per task with pause/resume, then generate timesheets and invoices that mark time as billed so you never double-charge.
features.benefit: Turn tracked hours into paid invoices without spreadsheet reconciliation.

banner.headline: Bill every minute.
banner.subhead: Timers to invoices — no double-charging, no spreadsheets.

impact.note: Differentiator; shipped (SCOPE-047 → SPEC-055/056/057). AI matches YOUR stack, not wxKanban's.

features.name: Generate Code in YOUR Stack & Style
features.valueProp: Point wxKanban at your real tech stack and a design you admire; generated scopes, specs, and code match it — never a silent default.
features.benefit: A non-designer ships a coherent, on-stack app by pointing at an example.

banner.headline: Your stack. Your look.
banner.subhead: AI generates to match — not a silent default.

impact.note: Ties wxKanban into VS Code — the daily developer surface. Kit + Cockpit both shipped (Marketplace).

features.benefit: Stay in your editor; the methodology and status come to you.

banner.headline: Your work, live in VS Code.
banner.subhead: Kit + Cockpit — what's left, health, next step.

impact.note: Consultant hub aggregates work + earnings + PM connections; shipped (SCOPE-037 v1.5.47).

features.valueProp: One work surface for every client: consolidated task queue, billable time, earnings, and external PM connections — hire or be hired inside the platform.
features.benefit: Run a whole consulting practice from a single pane.

banner.headline: Every client. One surface.
banner.subhead: Tasks, billable time, earnings, connections.

banner.headline: Catch the bugs users never report.
